create.noAccountHint: This job title cannot hold a login, so no password is set and no roles are assigned. They are still a full employee — you can grant access later if their title changes.

edit.title: Edit staff member
edit.accessHint: Roles and data access are not edited here — they decide what someone may reach, not what they do. Manage them from Users.

terminate.title: Terminate staff member?
terminate.description: {{name}} will be signed out immediately and can no longer sign in. Their record and history are kept.

grantAccess.title: Grant system access
grantAccess.description: Give {{name}} a login. They will sign in with their phone number and the password you set here.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Everyone who can sign into the system, and how

actions.search: Search by name, phone or code…

resetPassword.title: Reset password
resetPassword.description: Set a new password for {{name}}. You do not need their current one. They will be signed out everywhere and must use the new password.

disableLogin.title: Disable this login?
disableLogin.description: {{name}} will be signed out everywhere and refused at sign-in. Their password is kept, so enabling the login again lets them straight back in with the one they already know. Their roles are untouched.

enableLogin.title: Enable this login?
enableLogin.description: {{name}} will be able to sign in again with the password they already have. No new password is set and no roles change.

revokeAccess.title: Revoke system access?
revokeAccess.description: This deletes {{name}}'s login and their role grants — it is not the reversible Disable. Restoring access later means granting it again and setting a new password. They stay on the staff roster and keep their employment history.

editAccess.title: Edit access
editAccess.description: Choose what {{name}} can do once signed in. Replacing their roles signs them out, so they will need to sign in again.
